blurb: Guests can take riding lessons in English and Western disciplines, go on guided trail rides in Campbell Valley Park, or attend riding camps. Lessons and trail rides have various packages and pricing options. Boarding and training services are also offered with limited availability.
extraNote: Lessons may not be cancelled due to weather as they are held indoors · For extreme weather cancellations call ASAP · Cancellation deposit required for cancellations not due to extreme weather · Arrive 15 minutes before your ride · Waiver form required if parent/guardian not attending or group 10+ · Reservations recommended 3-4 days in advance, 1 week in summer
